notes: Maximum fiber reach is stated as 100 m (OM4/M5F), 70 m (OM3/M5E), and 20 m (OM2), not in km. Stressed/unstressed receiver OMA sensitivity is tabulated in mW (-5.2, -7.5, -10.1), not dBm. RxMAX average receiver power at 25.78 Gb/s is -10.3 to 3 mW (informative). LOS De-Assert row lists unit dB; value -13 interpreted as dBm per LOS context. Optical Center Wavelength row incorrectly shows dBm; wavelength range 840–860 nm applies. Footer © 2023 Coherent Corp.; body references Finisar Corporation. Transmitter Dispersion Penalty (TDP) max 2.5 dB @ 10.3 Gb/s and TDEC max 4.3 dB @ 25.7 Gb/s are not mapped to penalty objects (no paired penalized OSNR/sensitivity value). Supply current max 290 mA; total dissipation may exceed 1 W during link establishment below 25°C case temperature.
